author: SCOTT LEHTONEN
title: Stock Market Rallies, Dow Jones Stock Intel Plunges | Investor's Business Daily

organizations.name: intel stock stumbles among the dow jones

text:
The major stock indexes moved sharply higher early Friday. The Dow Jones industrials advanced more than 200 points in today's stock market . Leaderboard stock Starbucks ( SBUX ) neared a potential buy point on earnings, while Intel ( INTC ) plunged on earnings. Intel stock is a member of the Dow Jones industrials.
X
The tech-heavy Nasdaq composite moved up 1%. The S&P 500 index gained 0.8%, while the Dow Jones industrials also advanced 1%. ( For updates on this story and other market coverage, visit the Stock Market Today page.)
Dow Jones Stocks: Intel Stock Stumbles Among the Dow Jones stocks, Intel stock sold off 7% after its Q4 revenues missed the Street's targets. Meanwhile, the chip stock's guidance also disappointed investors. The Dow Jones stock broke down through its 50-day line, as a new base tries to take shape.
Meanwhile, Apple ( AAPL ) was one of the top performers, rising over 2%. Shares remain 33% off their 52-week high despite the recent stock market rally.

Please contact customer service CLOSE Stock Market Earnings: Intuitive Surgical Late Thursday, Intuitive Surgical ( ISRG ) reported mixed quarterly earnings results , sending shares sharply lower at the stock market open. The maker of robotic surgery devices declined 3%. Shares are still holding above their key 50-day support level.
Next week, a number of top stocks will report quarterly earnings, including PayPal ( PYPL ). PayPal stock is set to report on Wednesday after the stock market close. The top payment processor shows a buy point at 93.80. PayPal stock is breaking out above the entry amid the day's nearly 2% rise.
Can Starbucks Stock Brew Up A Breakout? Leaderboard stock Starbucks ( SBUX ) reported strong earnings results after the stock market close Thursday. The coffee giant beat fiscal Q1 targets on earnings, revenues and same-store sales. The firm also boosted its full-year profit guidance.
Shares popped 4% to take the 50-day line. Starbucks stock is nearing a flat base's 69.08 buy point. According to the IBD Stock Checkup , Starbucks stock boasts a 97 out of highest-possible 99 IBD Composite Rating. The Composite Rating is a blend of key fundamental and technical metrics designed to gauge a stock's leadership qualities.
IBD 50 Stocks To Watch: Twitter Stock Retakes Key Level Among the leading growth stocks , Twitter ( TWTR ) reclaimed its 50-day line early Friday with a 4% gain, as it fights to maintain that key level. Shares found resistance at their 200-day line last week.
On the downside, Illumina ( ILMN ) declined nearly 2%, extending a losing streak to four trading sessions. Shares are below their 200-day line.
